name: math_morphism_composition

VINIT.justification: the state before any objects or arrows are defined in the category

TANCH.justification: the requirement that all compositions remain within the defined category

AFWD.justification: the directed transformation from a source object to a target object

AREV.justification: the mapping that attempts to recover the source from the target

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of two morphisms into a single arrow

IMSCRIB.justification: the morphism that maps an object to itself and acts as the unit for composition

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of a morphism into its source and target types for compatibility verification

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the morphism from its validated source and target types

EVALT.justification: the affirmative state where the codomain of f equals the domain of g

EVALF.justification: the failure state where morphisms cannot be composed due to incompatible types

ENGAGR.justification: the state where a morphism and its inverse are held simultaneously as an equivalence

IFIX.justification: the permanent record of a specific composition result in the category structure

steps.domain_action: establish the initial empty category state
define the identity morphism for object A
record identity morphism id_A in the category
define morphism f from A to B
branch f to verify its codomain B
confirm codomain of f is B
define morphism g from B to C
branch g to verify its domain B
confirm domain of g matches codomain of f
compose g and f to create g ∘ f
record the resulting morphism h = g ∘ f
close the composition under category axioms

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: two separate morphisms f and g
